name: Rank
description: Use this oracle to randomly set the challenge rank of a quest, journey, or foe.

results.name: Troublesome
results.description:
A challenging quest with a small number of obstacles

Journey: Traveling a moderate distance within a single region Foe: Common enemies

results.name: Dangerous
results.description:
An involved quest with several obstacles

Journey: Traveling a long distance within a single region, or across rough terrain Foe: Capable fighters and deadly creatures

results.name: Formidable
results.description:
A complex quest with many obstacles

Journey: Traveling from one region to another, or across especially challenging terrain Foe: Exceptional fighters and mighty creatures

results.name: Extreme
results.description:
An intimidating quest with scores of obstacles

Journey: Traveling through multiple regions Foe: Foes of overwhelming skill or power

results.name: Epic
results.description:
A life-defining quest of unknowable scope

Journey: Traveling from one end of the Ironlands to another, or to a separate land Foe: Legendary foes of mythic power
